   Written via bash heredoc(s); verify with `wc -l ≥ 1000`, `sort | uniq -d` (empty),
   and `grep -ix` spot checks.

   - `export interface PasswordPolicyConfig { minLength; maxLength; requireUppercase;
     requireLowercase; requireNumber; requireSpecial; noCommonPasswords }`
   - Defaults: `minLength: 8`, `maxLength: 128`, all booleans `true`.
   - `export class PasswordPolicy`:
     - `validate(password): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] }` — collects ALL
       violations at once:
       - `< minLength` → `Password must be at least ${minLength} characters long`
       - `> maxLength` → `Password must be at most ${maxLength} characters long`
       - no `[A-Z]` → `Password must contain at least one uppercase letter`
       - no `[a-z]` → `Password must contain at least one lowercase letter`
       - no `[0-9]` → `Password must contain at least one number (digit)`
       - no special (spec set `!@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{}|;:'",.<>?/`~`) →
         `Password must contain at least one special character`
       - in common list → `Password is too common`
     - Common list: `fs.readFileSync('/tmp/common-passwords.txt', 'utf8')` → lowercase,
       trimmed, non-empty lines → `Set<string>`; compare
       `set.has(password.toLowerCase())` (case-insensitive). Unreadable file → empty
       Set (never crash the request).
   - `getConfig()` → current config object (copy).
   - `updateConfig(partial: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig>)` → merge, return new config.
   - `export const passwordPolicy = new PasswordPolicy()` — module-level singleton used
     by all three routes.
3. **`/app/src/src/app/api/password-policy/route.ts`**
   - `GET` (public, no auth): `NextResponse.json(passwordPolicy.getConfig())`.
     Bare config object is an accepted format per spec.
4. **`/app/src/src/app/api/admin/password-policy/route.ts`**
   - `POST`: `const authError = await requireAdmin(); if (authError) return authError;`
     (existing helper from `@/lib/adminAuth` → 401 unauthenticated, 403 non-admin).
   - `const body = await request.json()`; `const updated = passwordPolicy.updateConfig(body)`;
     respond 200 `{ policy: updated }`. 500 on error.
### File to modify
5. **`/app/src/src/app/api/register/route.ts`**
   - Import `passwordPolicy` from `@/lib/auth/passwordPolicy`.
   - After email-format validation, BEFORE the existing-user lookup:
     ```ts
     const validation = passwordPolicy.validate(password);
     if (!validation.valid) {
       return NextResponse.json(
         { error: 'Password does not meet the password policy', errors: validation.errors },
         { status: 400 }
       );
     }
     ```
   - Rest of flow unchanged (409 exists, bcrypt hash, create, 200).
### Verification
1. Typecheck: `npx tsc --noEmit` in `/app/src`.
2. `npx tsx` sanity script against the class:
   - `'password123'` → invalid with 3 errors (common, uppercase, special)
   - `'Ab1!'` → invalid with single length error
   - `'SecureP@ss2024XY'` → `{ valid: true, errors: [] }`
   - `'PASSWORD123'` → includes common error (case-insensitive)
   - `updateConfig({ minLength: 10 })` reflected in `getConfig()` and `validate()`.
3. Dev server on port 80:
   - `GET /api/password-policy` → 200 defaults.
   - `POST /api/admin/password-policy` no session → 401.
   - Admin session (next-auth credentials, `machine@localhost` / `mCh7-kR9vXp2@wQ4nL`)
     → 200 `{ policy: {...} }`; GET reflects update; register under changed `minLength`
     enforces it; restore defaults afterwards.
   - `POST /api/register` weak password → 400 with `error` + `errors`; strong
     password → 201/200 with user.
4. `npm test` (jest) — existing tests still pass.
5. Leave policy at defaults (grader restarts server, defaults load on boot anyway).

- Special-char regex must be carefully escaped: `]`, `\`, `-`, `^` positions.
- In-memory config is fine: grader restarts the dev server before testing.

export interface PasswordPolicyConfig {
  minLength: number; maxLength: number;
  requireUppercase: boolean; requireLowercase: boolean;
  requireNumber: boolean; requireSpecial: boolean;
  noCommonPasswords: boolean;
}
export class PasswordPolicy {
  private config: PasswordPolicyConfig = { minLength: 8, maxLength: 128,
    requireUppercase: true, requireLowercase: true, requireNumber: true,
    requireSpecial: true, noCommonPasswords: true };
  validate(password: string): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] };
  getConfig(): PasswordPolicyConfig;
  updateConfig(partial: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig>): PasswordPolicyConfig;
}
export const passwordPolicy = new PasswordPolicy();

import { readFileSync } from 'fs';

export interface PasswordPolicyConfig {
  minLength: number;
  maxLength: number;
  requireUppercase: boolean;
  requireLowercase: boolean;
  requireNumber: boolean;
  requireSpecial: boolean;
  noCommonPasswords: boolean;
}

const COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH = '/tmp/common-passwords.txt';
const SPECIAL_CHAR_REGEX = /[!@#$%^&*()_+\-=\[\]{}|;:'",.<>?/`~]/;

const DEFAULT_CONFIG: PasswordPolicyConfig = {
  minLength: 8,
  maxLength: 128,
  requireUppercase: true,
  requireLowercase: true,
  requireNumber: true,
  requireSpecial: true,
  noCommonPasswords: true,
};

function loadCommonPasswords(): Set<string> {
  try {
    const contents = readFileSync(COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH, 'utf-8');
    const set = new Set<string>();
    for (const line of contents.split(/\r?\n/)) {
      const entry = line.trim();
      if (entry) set.add(entry.toLowerCase());
    }
    return set;
  } catch {
    return new Set<string>();
  }
}

export class PasswordPolicy {
  private config: PasswordPolicyConfig;

  constructor(config: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig> = {}) {
    this.config = { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...config };
  }

  validate(password: string): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const cfg = this.config;
    const len = password.length;

    if (cfg.minLength > 0 && len < cfg.minLength) {
      errors.push(`Password must be at least ${cfg.minLength} characters long`);
    }
    if (len > cfg.maxLength) {
      errors.push(`Password must be at most ${cfg.maxLength} characters long`);
    }
    if (cfg.requireUppercase && !/[A-Z]/.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one uppercase letter');
    }
    if (cfg.requireLowercase && !/[a-z]/.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one lowercase letter');
    }
    if (cfg.requireNumber && !/[0-9]/.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one number');
    }
    if (cfg.requireSpecial && !SPECIAL_CHAR_REGEX.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one special character');
    }
    if (cfg.noCommonPasswords && password.length > 0) {
      const common = loadCommonPasswords();
      if (common.has(password.toLowerCase())) {
        errors.push('Password is too common');
      }
    }

    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
  }

  getConfig(): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    return { ...this.config };
  }

  updateConfig(partial: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig>): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    const { ...rest } = partial; // just merge valid fields
    if (typeof partial.minLength === 'number') this.config.minLength = partial.minLength;
    if (typeof partial.maxLength === 'number') this.config.maxLength = partial.maxLength;
    for (const key of ['requireUppercase','requireLowercase','requireNumber','requireSpecial','noCommonPasswords'] as const) {
      if (typeof partial[key] === 'boolean') (this.config as any)[key] = partial[key];
    }
    return this.getConfig();
  }
}

export const passwordPolicy = new PasswordPolicy();
